Rz cancels the RHP zero. The tail is 20 uA, so SR = 20 V/us, and the stage-2 current is 80 uA. Polarity: vinp drives the mirror-output side and the CS stage inverts, so vout is non-inverting."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),      # input pair L
    "Itail": (20e-6, 8e-6, 60e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),       # PMOS load / M6 length (shared for matching)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),     # PMOS load / M6 gm/Id
    "I6":    (80e-6, 30e-6, 250e-6),# second-stage current
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.3e-12, 3e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),       # Rz = kRz/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["Itail"]; I6 = p["I6"]; Cc = p["Cc"]
    gmidn = 10.0

    # bias mirror (all NMOS sources same L and gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m3_vds if False else 0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    # second stage PMOS CS: same gm/Id and L as load -> zero systematic offset
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # diff pair: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (out1 inverting wrt vinp)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # compensation
    Rz = p["kRz"] / m6.gm
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (cl * Cc + c1 * (cl + Cc)))
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2))
    # residual zero (LHP if Rz > 1/gm6) adds some phase
    if Rz > 1 / m6.gm:
        z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1 / m6.gm))
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (1 / (2 * PI * Rz * c1 + 1e-30))))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew}
